overall_notes: The paper focuses on compositional generalization in data-to-text generation using T5 models. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric variants and clarification that BLEURT is used for training (pseudo-response selection) rather than as an evaluation metric. Human evaluation was well-documented with clear criteria.
